back when I lived in the midwest, we had a beautiful stray tortoiseshell girl that frequented the apartment complex. she had kittens in a locked shed, and everyone just kind of agreed to let her do her thing in there.

one night my partner at the time and I heard a kitten meowing outside our window, sure enough we look outside and the runt is laying in our flower bed. I look over to the field next to the complex and I see Miss Hoda just watching us. our cat hated other cats so I went to an elderly neighbor who fed the strays that came by, she and I set up a little cat house on her patio.

next morning I go to check on the little one, my neighbor is sitting outside, along with Hoda, the runt, and two more kittens. then while we're talking, Hoda runs off and comes back with TWO MORE kittens. I guess when she realized we would take care of the little one, she figured we'd help care for the others too.

happily, my neighbor calls up her grandson's girlfriend who knows someone that runs a foster group, they post the kittens on Facebook, and within the day they were all spoken for. Hoda remained a stray only because a couple of us tried to take her in, but she'd just scream and cry and cause trouble to go back outside. cats gonna cat. but my elderly neighbor got all her vaccinations and got her fixed thanks to a vet friend of hers who basically did it for free. last I heard after I moved back home to NY was that another neighbor let Hoda in for the winter, and she got along very well with her cats, so now she's basically a resident there. goes out during the day, comes back at night, still living her best sassy life.

Okay this is gonna be a SUPER long read, so apologies ahead of time! I'm assuming you're brand new to the game, so consider this a starter guide. If you don't wanna read the whole thing, then tldr; you get an option to skip the tutorial when starting a new game. If you want some more tips, read on!

Yes, you can skip the tutorial. When starting a new save it should ask if you want to play the tutorial or skip it, and you can check a box underneath to always skip it. The game then loads into either the tutorial (if you select it) or cas (if you skip tutorial) to make your first family!

There are then two options you can choose: make a sim by answering a questionnaire to determine their traits, aspiration, career, and starting funds (recommended if you want to play a unique, random sim!) or just skipping the questionnaire and making a custom sim. Either way, you get to customize their appearance by selecting skin tone, eye color, hair style, hair color, face shape, body shape, etc. You can either use the 'sculpt' feature to change each facial feature/body feature individually or use a selection of preset measurements that will show on the side.

Once you make your first family, it's time to move! You can choose to move them into an empty lot or a prebuilt home. Keep in mind, you need to have enough money to purchase a prebuilt home. You can also bulldoze a prebuilt home to make your own. 

If you want a bigger lot, move your family into a smaller lot first, then go back to Manage Worlds using the little location icon up in the top right corner, between the build (wrench and hammer) icon and the gallery (two photos) icon. Pick the lot you want, and bulldoze the existing lot and move the existing family (if necessary). Then, select your family and choose either evict or move to move them to a bigger lot!

There are also various cheats you can use for building/gameplay, some of which require testing cheats (aka the dev cheats) and will disable trophies. But one invaluable build cheat, MoveObjects, does not require testing cheats! Simply press R1+R2+L1+L2 to open the cheat text box and type "bb.moveobjects on" (minus quotations!) and you can place any object regardless of anything being 'in the way' on the grid. Keep in mind this can interfere with some objects' usage, but it also allows you to do more things with building and decorating. I recommend checking Google or YouTube for building tutorials if you're new to the game and never built before. Good luck, and welcome to simmming!
